threads.body: The legacy flat-OpenAI branch triggers for any tool entry that has a top-level `name`, even when `type` is present but not `"function"`. That changes prior behavior (non-function tool types were skipped) and can misclassify non-function tool definitions as `FunctionToolDefinition` (e.g., vendor-specific tool types that still carry a `name`). Restrict the legacy path to only run when the entry has no `type`.
